exposure: national guidelines for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 34,794 singleton births in Finland between 2006-2008 and 36,488 singleton births between 2010-2012
finding: Implementing national guidelines for GDM in Finland, which changed screening from risk-based to comprehensive, led to a significant increase in GDM diagnoses but did not improve pregnancy or neonatal outcomes.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight decreased from 3647 ± 575 g to 3567 ± 575 g
